title: TC-E2E-002 + PILOT-01: approval gate, then campaign to reconciled revenue (mocked SoR)
risk: A campaign publishes without approval, or stops at 'sent': with no response, order and reconciled revenue there is no evidence the marketing spend worked.
preconditions: run_id=RUN-E2E-OFF-MKT, case_id=E2E-OFF-MKT, worker=w-biz-e2e; the mock channel adapter counts sends per effect_key and returns provider references
campaign CAMP-0115-01 targets segment SEG-atrisk-0115, the brand audit for DRAFT-0115-07 returned compliant=true and no approval row exists yet

inputs.brief: win-back the at-risk cohort with the 24-month battery warranty message
inputs.response_script: sandboxed reply 'cho toi dat hang' then order ORD-MKT-0115-01 at 900 TWD

steps.expected: the run records the brief, the consent-filtered segment, the content draft and the brand audit verdict; the draft stays in state DRAFT
dispatch_campaign returns APPROVAL_REQUIRED; the mock channel adapter records 0 sends and exactly one PENDING approval row exists for the run

after the operator approval bound to EK-CAMP-0115-01-EMAIL the publish executes once; recipient_count counts only consent-verified members (opt-out customer excluded) and the adapter logs one send with a provider reference

steps.action: Drive the customer response into Sales
steps.expected: the scripted reply opens a Sales conversation routed by the orchestrator (no peer-to-peer MKT->SAL call) and SAL-03 returns a 7-field recommendation for SKU-OK
SAL-02 creates ORD-MKT-0115-01 through create_order using the server-signed price quote, and the order is reconciled against the ERP mock
evaluate_attribution returns attributed_orders=1 and attributed_revenue=900 TWD for LAST_TOUCH with roas from the approved spend, and LEARNING records the result

assertions: pre-approval publish attempts produce zero sends and the only send is covered by the approval row bound to the effect_key (TC-E2E-002)
the post-approval send reaches only consent-verified recipients: the opt-out customer is never contacted and recipient_count equals the eligible count
the revenue chain is complete and ordered: campaign/send -> customer response -> sales conversation -> recommendation -> order id -> attributed revenue 900 TWD
stopping at 'sent' fails the journey: the response, the order and the attribution figures must exist before this case passes
forbidden: publishing or resending the campaign without a bound approval
reporting campaign revenue without a reconciled order, or passing the marketing pilot on send count alone
evidence: approval row for the effect_key plus the channel adapter send log
order ORD-MKT-0115-01 as returned by the ERP mock and the conversation trace
attribution payload (revenue, orders, roas) and the campaign LEARNING record
cleanup: cancel/withdraw the campaign draft and scheduled sends in the mock and drop run RUN-E2E-OFF-MKT; keep the approval and attribution evidence

Campaign lifecycle, approval gate, attribution and order creation run as real components over the mocked SoR and channel.
